description: This Java interface defines a contract for exceptions related to placeholders in the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes an error code prefix used for placeholder-related exceptions.

classes.name: PlaceholderException
classes.description: An interface that groups all exceptions related to placeholders and provides an error code prefix for such errors.

methods.name: ERROR_CODE_PREFIX
methods.description: A string constant serving as the prefix for error codes thrown within the scope of placeholders.
